system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while at least one creature is standing on an active Web Anchor. You pull on the threads you set long ago, and cause one Web Anchor to collapse on itself. All creatures standing on the chosen Web Anchor when this jutsu is cast is forced to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are encased in a silk Cocoon for the duration.

An encased creature is Incapacitated, Blinded and Deafened, but well encased in their cocoon. The Cocoon has an AC equal to your jutsu save DC, 40 hit points, 10 DR immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage and cannot be moved except by you. The sealed creature can spend its Action on its turn, even while Incapacitated, to make their Strength saving throw to escape on a success. If the cocoon is reduced to 0 hit points, the encased creature is able to escape. Any remaining damage targeting the cocoon does not transfer to the encased creature.

While a creature is encased, once per turn, on your turn, you can constrict the cocoon, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning damage directly to the encases creature. A creature that dies within the cocoon is perfectly preserved.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the cocoons hit points by +10. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, it increases its DR by +4.
